name: Yashiro Haruka
source:
Born and raised in Sapporo. He was born into a family of ordinary salarymen. He was living a high school life without having any particular dreams for the future. In the fall of his third year of high school, he arranged his sister's hair for a party and she was delighted. This triggered a change in his plans from university to a two-year vocational school for beauticians.

A year ago, he opened his own shop called "campanella." He's self-paced and spontaneous. Although he's as kind as an old man, he still has young taste.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
